sourcePreservation.scope: Every original archived column/row and sequence; added columns verified separately without invented historical evidence.

coverage: Ordered install of all eight candidates, wrong target/catalog drift/late rollback/duplicate rejection and original data preservation.
Customer identity links use strong source/channel evidence; name-only and ambiguous or contradictory channels never silently merge people.
Customers, companies, sites and jobs keep exact source relationships; contradictory exact site identity cannot fall back to a guessed address.
Two distinct phone numbers survive an atomic customer import with one primary per channel; replay preserves existing primary contact points.
Durable row outcomes and retry attempts preserve idempotency, recorded errors, review conflicts and honest incomplete finalisation.
Imported endpoints do not establish marketing consent; existing suppressions retain precedence.
Customer cards are created without invented scores/activity; existing card fields and person records remain unchanged; another source alias reuses the same card.
Bounded 100-row customer batch, exact retry, sanitized per-row failure, late-contract rollback, sites/jobs, wrong-tenant and View-As denials.
fixtureAdaptations: Production already creates profiles through auth.users; the three legacy profile inserts update the synthetic existing profile on conflict.
Historical import assertions are followed by the supplemental two-phone and exact-site recovery checks inside the same rollback transaction.
Three intentional global import templates are compared to pinned source definitions; original import-profile rows are separately compared byte-for-byte.

Baseline v1 ended on a missing search path in the aggregate inspection; v2 corrected that inspection. Rehearsal v1 detected the unaccounted template additions; v2 explicitly checks them and rejects conflicting pre-existing templates.
limitations: No production or hosted TEST changes, provider requests, real-customer import or signed-in acceptance.
Commusoft API intake, contacts traversal, operator approval/recovery and real coverage reconciliation remain required.
All customer/job/card journeys use synthetic fixtures on the real archived schema.
Preservation covers the retained archive, excluding known pg_net omissions; full service/Vault recovery remains open.
